title: Log a support ticket
use_when: The caller needs follow-up from the support team: a fault that could not be fixed on the phone, an arm fault, paid but not working, a double charge, or a request to be called back.

device_id.label: Device ID
device_id.ask: the Device ID, only if they don't know the bed

callback_number.label: Callback number
callback_number.ask: an Australian mobile or landline number for a callback

issue_summary.label: Problem
issue_summary.ask: what the problem is, for the support ticket (include the identified terminal if known)

problem_spoken.label: Problem (as read back)
problem_spoken.ask: the problem and anything already tried, as one short spoken sentence to the caller for the read-back, for example: the screen on your bedside terminal is completely black, and pressing the orange button didn't bring it back

steps_tried.label: Already tried
steps_tried.ask: approved steps already tried on this call

urgent.label: Urgent
urgent.ask: true when the caller paid and it is not working, or was charged twice

steps.title: Understand the problem
steps.instruction: Make sure you understand the problem and what has already been tried, then record it twice in one flow_record: issue_summary for the support ticket, and problem_spoken as one short plain sentence to the caller for the read-back. Mark it urgent if the caller paid and it is not working, or was charged twice.

steps.title: Where is the screen
steps.instruction: Ask which hospital, then the bed number (or the Device ID if they don't know the bed). One question at a time.

steps.title: Who to call back
steps.instruction: Ask for the caller's name, then an Australian number to call back on. One question at a time.

steps.title: Read back and confirm
steps.instruction: Say the read-back exactly as written, word for word, then stop and wait for the caller's answer. Then call flow_confirm with yes or no. If something is wrong, ask what to change and record the corrected value.

steps.title: Log the ticket in Zoho Desk
steps.instruction: The system logs the ticket after a yes.

readback: , and the best number to call you back on is {callback_number}.
on_success: Tell the caller their ticket is logged and read the ticket number out, digit by digit. Do not promise a callback time.
on_failure: Say honestly that the ticket could not be logged, apologise, and do not try again on this call.
